notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0 Notes:
-------------------------
[b]-New Interactable:[/b] Alchemy table! Learn and brew powerful potions available at level 12.
[b]-New Powerup:[/b] Ability Powerup! New powerup type will spawn in the world granting the player different ability effects.
-Spells can now be unlearned at the orb. Use coins to respecialize and choose new abilities. The cost to do this doubles each time used.
-Minerals can now be upgraded at the anvil like gems. Combine 10 lesser minerals to create 1 better mineral.
-Storm spawn time increased (You now have more time before storm spawns). 
-Gold drop rate increased.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 Notes:
-------------------------
-Dash keybinding change:[b] W -> Right Click[/b] (re-mappable)
-Enemy balancing: Speed, health, armor, and damage/healing were adjusted for some enemies.
-Lowered projectile/melee knockback for normal player/enemy attacks
-World rendering efficiency improvements

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released!
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 Notes:
---------------------------
-Attack animations and hitboxes have been made more responsive
-Hover over items in the world to see item tooltip
-Stack count displayed on item tooltip
-Dash keybinding changed from (W+Space) -> (W)
-Slam keybinding changed from (S+Space) -> (S)
-Bag can now be opened/closed with (B)
-Gear can now be opened/closed with (G)
-Journal can now be opened/closed with (V)
-Added patch notes viewer to main menu, access by clicking "!" button in bottom right
-Selling items in the shop should be more obvious
-Vsync option now saved
-UI resized slightly smaller
-Fixed various combat bugs (thanks dSid!)
